author: GitHub
description:
When executive pressure to adopt AI meets everyday workplace tools, security boundaries are often the first thing to disappear. In this clip from our interview with cybersecurity researcher Niels Provos, learn why installing autonomous AI agents with unrestricted access to your email, calendar, and data creates major enterprise risks. Many third-party agent skills can harbor hidden malicious behavior, turning convenience into a serious vulnerability. Watch the full interview on the GitHub channel to explore how to secure autonomous workflows safely.

author: GitHub
description:
How do you clear a massive governance backlog without destroying developer velocity? In just four days, Jeff Doolittle of Trimble used GitHub Copilot to build an automated system and rapidly clear the backlog without manually writing a single line of code. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, you’ll learn how to use AI not just as a coding assistant, but as an architectural force multiplier. You'll leave knowing how to combine automated GitHub Actions with custom Copilot prompts to eliminate developer toil, easily enforce remediation lifecycles, and tackle technical debt across your engineering organization. 

Speaker: 
Jeff Doolittle, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, Trimble 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AArI948SDz8&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU
